title: Claim-level provenance entry
description: One entry per individual professional action/claim in 01-SALIM-BURAK-DIGITAL-TWIN/registry/professional-experience.yaml (a single what_i_did bullet or other_professional_project_exposure item). Post-Codex fix (P1-05): a broad file-level source declaration is not enough to prove every individual claim is real — this schema lets the validator check CLAIM-LEVEL provenance, not just file-level.

claim_type.description: WHAT_I_DID claims must carry professional_case_id; OTHER_PROFESSIONAL_PROJECT_EXPOSURE claims must not (that list has no case-level id in professional-experience.yaml).

text.description: Must be an EXACT, byte-for-byte match of the bullet text in professional-experience.yaml this claim sources. The validator diffs these directly — this is the mechanism that makes an invented, unsourced bullet fail validation.

source_id.description: Must resolve to a real entry in source-provenance.yaml#sources.

verification_state.description: SOURCED: the source_id genuinely contains this claim's content. USER_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED: reserved for a future claim awaiting confirmation — such a claim must not simultaneously appear as a live bullet in professional-experience.yaml (it would then be an unconfirmed claim being presented as settled fact).
